records.title: Advancing Tool-Augmented Large Language Models: Integrating Insights from Errors in Inference Trees
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.07115. Abstract summary: Tool-augmented large language models (LLMs) leverage tools, often in the form of APIs, to improve their reasoning capabilities on complex tasks. This enables them to act as intelligent agents interacting with the real world. The recently introduced ToolLLaMA model by Qin et al. records.title: Discovering Sparsity Allocation for Layer-wise Pruning of Large Language Models
records.reason: LLM pruning is relevant to compression, but no measured inference-runtime gain is established.

records.title: EverMemOS: A Self-Organizing Memory Operating System for Structured Long-Horizon Reasoning
records.reason: Memory retrieval can affect context cost, but a reusable serving-efficiency gain is not isolated.

records.reason: Measured efficiency exists but LLM validation is limited to 350M scale and does not establish larger decoder-serving relevance.
